findings.codeql_raw_query:
/**
 * @name SSRF vulnerability in JWKS URL handling
 * @description Unvalidated URLs in JWKS client could lead to SSRF attacks
 * @kind problem
 * @problem.severity warning
 * @id py/jwt-ssrf-jwks
 * @tags security
 *        external/cwe/cwe-918
 */

import python
import semmle.python.ApiGraphs

from DataFlow::CallCfgNode call
where
  (
    call = API::moduleImport("urllib").getMember("request").getMember("urlopen").getACall() or
    call = API::moduleImport("urllib").getMember("request").getMember("Request").getACall()
  )
select call, "HTTP request that may be vulnerable to SSRF if URL is not properly validated"
findings.hypothesis: SSRF vulnerability in JWKS client URL handling - checking if URLs are validated before making HTTP requests
